# `admin.mirror.retry`

Retry a failed mirror run

Site admins only. Flags the mirror manual-due again so the scheduler re-runs it. Refuses runs that did not fail.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/mirror/runs/{run}/retry`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin mirror retry`
- MCP: `admin_mirror_retry`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `run` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
